name: Conjuring Up Spirits
overview: Scripture clearly warns against seeking guidance from conjuring spirits, familiar spirits, wizards, or necromancers, as seen in Deuteronomy 18:11 and Isaiah 8:19, where God questions why the living would seek the dead instead of Him. Deuteronomy 13:1 cautions against prophets or dreamers who perform signs or wonders that lead people away from God. Instead, the New Testament demonstrates Christ’s authority over unclean spirits (Mark 6:7) and emphasizes that deliverance from such forces comes through prayer and fasting (Mark 9:29), underscoring the necessity of relying on God rather than occult practices.
